payload.purpose_context: Operator ruling 2 of 2026-10-31 (#6117) asks for an optional spec-kitty-services platform wheel that carries the pinned, digest-verified write and charter service binaries and fills the reserved spec_kitty.service_binaries slot, so teams can install the full stack offline in one command. The main spec-kitty-cli wheel keeps shipping pins only and fetching on first use. Tracked by #6904.
payload.purpose_tldr: Offer a one-command offline install of the service binaries through an optional companion wheel, while the main CLI wheel stays pure.

payload.question: Accept the 12 recommendations in docs/plans/events-domain-move/companion-wheel-research.md section 3 (name, extra, version lock, contents, fallback wheel, manylinux_2_39 tag, 95/60 MB size gate, stdlib build in packages/spec-kitty-services/, own pypi-services publish before the CLI, fallback-only while pins are empty, sync_services in release.yml + checklist, one PR with the ADR amendment first)?

payload.final_answer: All 12 as recommended (operator ruling 2026-10-31, relayed by the orchestrator session)

payload.question: The exact services extra (spec-kitty-services==<cli version>) makes uv lock unsatisfiable because the companion of that version is never on PyPI at release-commit time. Keep the extra via a uv workspace member (packages/spec-kitty-services, [tool.uv.workspace] + [tool.uv.sources] workspace=true), or drop the extra and document a separate pip install?

payload.final_answer: A: uv workspace member with a stdlib in-tree PEP 517 backend; clarify the CLAUDE.md bullet and the ADR amendment; guard the version lock (companion == CLI == extra pin) in a test, RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md and validate_release.py (operator ruling 2026-10-31, relayed)
